theme: Hybrid (Light and Dark Mode Support with toggle)
design_philosophy: Swiss High-Contrast combined with Modern Institutional. Clean, dense, data-rich but emotionally grounded through crisp typography and sharp geometry. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics.

body.style: leading-relaxed for long text, clean legibility.

scale.rules: Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between heading and subhead max 2 steps.

colors.rules: No pure black or pure white. Tint neutral greys with a bit of blue. Use APCA contrast. Dark surfaces should be layered for depth without heavy drop shadows.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for Dashboards (technical look, border-collapse, exposed skeleton). Glassmorphism (Crystal variant) for Sticky Headers (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70 or bg-black/60, saturate-150, 1px inner stroke).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, layered ambient shadows in light mode. Minimal shadows in dark mode (use surface lightness to distinguish cards).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle solid borders for data cards instead of soft fuzzy shadows.

components.general: Raw HTML/Tailwind for landing page layouts (bento grids, overlaps). Shadcn UI for complex interactive parts (Forms, Dialogs, Select, DatePicker, Tables).
components.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, sharp or max 8px border-radius. Avoid over-shadowing.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Line for trends, bar for comparisons. Tooltips must be accessible.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional tech looks.

grids.landing: Bento Grid Protocol Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetry, visual tension, gap-8 to gap-12. Avoid centered symmetric generic layouts.
grids.dashboard: High Density Grid Mode B. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized, no jagged bottoms.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) where content breathes. Internal padding for bordered containers to prevent collision.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs and dense content. Mobile-first grid-cols-1.
layouts.navigation: Visible navbar with Logo, Links, CTA. Never hide behind hamburger on desktop. Fixed/Sticky must have z-50 and solid/glass background. Do not use fully transparent navbars.

motion.rules: Micro-animations on hover/click/focus. No 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Normal text 4.5:1, UI components 3:1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., login-form-submit-button).
accessibility.states: Explicit text color on hover. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.

media.rules: Never use placeholders. Use provided images. Max-height 80vh on mobile.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Leaflet (react-leaflet) or React Map GL for the GPS mapping vibe and actual tracking functionality.
3d_libraries.steps: 1. npm install react-leaflet leaflet or react-map-gl. 2. For UI overlays over map, do not use fully transparent backgrounds. 3. Include custom markers for student locations/GPS visit verified spots.

instructions_to_main_agent: Run yarn add @phosphor-icons/react react-leaflet leaflet recharts sonner
Implement light and dark themes using Tailwind's 'dark:' class strategy.
Build the dashboard using a collapsible sidebar and dense CSS grid for widgets.
Follow the Bento Grid protocol for the landing page.
Use Shadcn JS files, NOT TSX, according to project specs.
Use sonner for toast notifications. Shadcn components are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT:
You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
- Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
- Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
- Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
- You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
- You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
- Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
- NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
- Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
- Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Component Reuse:
- Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
- Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Toasts:
- Use sonner for toasts
- Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
